subject: Mobile Development
title: The Cost of Building an App
description: A 60-second lesson on The Cost of Building an App.

hook.text: A basic mobile app costs $50,000 to build. A complex one can cost over $500,000.

buildup.text: Development costs include design, engineering, testing, backend infrastructure, and launch.

discovery.text: Building for both iOS and Android roughly doubles the engineering effort and budget.

twist.text: The biggest cost isn't building the app — it's maintaining, updating, and growing it after launch.

climax.text: App development is expensive upfront and even more expensive to sustain long-term.

punchline.text: Building is the easy part — maintenance is the real cost.

quiz.question: What is often the biggest cost of a mobile app?
options: Ongoing maintenance and updates after launch
